note: Small primitive Corps of Engineers campground on the north end of Norfork Lake: sites strung along the shore road, six of them on the open bank above a rock ledge, the other two across the road by the east parking area. Half the sites have a water hookup. No toilets are listed. --Claude
summary: Live on recreation.gov. Confirmed 8 sites (49-72 ft, all non-electric, 4 with water), $14/$16, 14-night limit, no minimum stay. Reservations run May 1 - Sep 29 only; what happens outside that is unread, so season is left unset. Lakefront confirmed (6 of 8 sites). Pin on site 5, no move. Phone lead 870-425-2700.
flags: LIVE: the facility is active on recreation.gov (is_deactivated false); the 2027 calendar shows all 8 sites 'Available' from 2027-05-01 (the booking window reaches 2027-05-09 today), then 'Open'/'NYR' to 2027-09-29.

SEASON UNSET: the calendar and the rate table cover only May 1 - Sep 29 (written as booking.season). October-April nights carry no status at all and no off-season rate exists, which may mean closed or may mean first-come with no fee - nothing read says which, so `season` is not written. No Corps Norfork Lake page was read for this.

FACILITY TEXT VERSUS SITE RECORDS: the description says 'The 9 campsites within the park' and the amenity list says 'Electric Hookups'; the per-site records are 8 sites, every one STANDARD NONELECTRIC. The site records rule: 8 sites, no electric (stored values already agree).

WATERFRONT - LAKEFRONT STANDS (6 of 8): sites 3 and 4 are pull-offs on the lake side of the park road 20-25 m from the top of the bank; sites 5, 6, 7 and 8 are on short spurs on the lake side, 15-30 m from the bank; open mown ground with scattered trees and nothing between in each case. The bank is a bare rock ledge a few metres high at the imagery's lake level. Sites 1 and 2 are at the east parking area on the inland side of the park road (road between: lakeview).
PIN: stored 36.544645,-92.285654 is site 5's own coordinate, on the campground. No move. (The recreation.gov facility point 36.544361,-92.282473 is 290 m east, past sites 1-2; not the stored pin.)
PHONE (lead, not written by apply): no phone stored; recreation.gov says 'For facility specific information, please call (870) 425-2700' (the Corps' Norfork Lake project office).
FACILITIES: no toilet, shower or dump amenity is listed on the facility or any site, and none was identified on imagery (a small structure by the east parking area was not identifiable). Not written.
ACCESS: paved to the park (Highway O per the directions); no length or grade posting. Rules posted: 'Off-road vehicles are not permitted', 'No livestock', 'No firearms'.
